# Claude Code fixtures

Anonymised transcripts. **Every field name, type and nesting level is copied
from a census of 4,238 real records** written by Claude Code 2.1.229–2.1.237 on
Windows; **every piece of content is invented.** No line here came out of a real
conversation.

That split is deliberate. PLAN.md §6.8.1 bans fixtures generated by the code
under test — a fixture the exporter wrote proves only that the exporter is
self-consistent. What makes these real is the *shape*, and the shape is what the
reader can get wrong. What makes them safe to commit is that the content is not.

| File | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `basic.jsonl` | An ordinary session: every record type and every content block type, in the proportions the real data had |
| `edge.jsonl` | The things that break naive readers — bare-string content, an inline image, a spilled tool output, unknown record and block types, a malformed line, a blank line, a bare array |
| `empty.jsonl` | Metadata records only, no messages. A session that must be skipped, not exported as empty |

Record and block field names were taken from the census recorded in
PROGRESS.md §4.1 — notably `thinking` carries its text under `thinking` (not
`text`), `tool_result` carries its payload under `content` (not `output`), and
`tool_use` has an `id` that UCS has nowhere to put.
